description: Source file implementing the DisplayColorProfile class and related functions for managing display color profiles, including color modes, HDR capabilities, and dataspace mappings within the Android SurfaceFlinger composition engine.

classes.name: DisplayColorProfile
classes.description: Manages display color profiles, including supported color modes, HDR capabilities, and dataspace mappings.

methods.name: createDisplayColorProfile
methods.description: Factory function to create a unique pointer to a DisplayColorProfile instance.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::DisplayColorProfile
methods.description: Constructor initializing display color profile based on creation arguments, including HDR and color mode support.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::isValid
methods.description: Checks if the display color profile is valid.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::hasWideColorGamut
methods.description: Returns whether the display supports wide color gamut.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::populateColorModes
methods.description: Populates supported color modes and render intents based on hardware capabilities.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::addColorMode
methods.description: Maps dataspace, color mode, and render intent to supported hardware configurations.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::hasRenderIntent
methods.description: Checks if a specific render intent is supported.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::hasLegacyHdrSupport
methods.description: Checks for legacy HDR support for specific dataspace.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::getBestColorMode
methods.description: Retrieves the best supported dataspace, color mode, and render intent for given inputs.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::isDataspaceSupported
methods.description: Checks if a dataspace is supported.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::getTargetDataspace
methods.description: Determines target dataspace based on color mode and current dataspace.

methods.name: DisplayColorProfile::dump
methods.description: Outputs the current display color profile state for debugging.
